termination: Actual and imagined fall at root height <0.35m or upright Z<0.5. Reference end is finite-task terminal with zero tail; score terminal-step reward once. Model fall mask is hard and not differentiated.
common_prior: One identical pre-supervision zero-output checkpoint for all methods and training seeds. It includes previously fitted balance slopes, static kinematics and normalization from reference-source observations; no claim of training from scratch or a prior-free mocap method. Independently seeded collection/optimization defines the three new training runs.
data_access: Reuse the preceding validated study's zero actor, initial physics, common first collections, diagnostics and complete prefix-only baseline. Reconstruct common learning tensors exactly from float32 archives. New replay-prefix models/critics are initialized and fitted afresh; their first common fits must match the source baseline. Only later own-policy collection/final evaluation is new physics. Source controls remain commands/reset setup, never fitting labels.
critic: Physical-return critics are fitted/stored with the unchanged 128 updates per cycle in both arms, but neither actor objective calls its critic. This retains the original baseline budget; no new critic recipe is tested.
actor_objective: Both arms optimize H32 discounted reference reward with no critic tail and the same Adam/step-cap budget. Prefix-only samples episode reset starts. Replay-prefix samples uniformly with replacement from every pre-action state in the current cycle's physical collection, preserving its H10 history, actual/reference causal EMA, original reset origin and current phase. Longer episodes therefore receive more weight; this is a changed training-state distribution, not an isolated effect of elapsed time. No terminal post-state or another episode's frames seed an imagined rollout. All sampled replay indices and episode-relative ages are recorded.
budget_and_selection: Three seeds and cycles; 27 collection episodes at 0/10/20s origins, 900 model/128 value fitting updates and 12 actor steps per cycle. Same raw noise and 0.005 local logit RMS cap. Reuse all three frozen reset-only baseline runs; train only three new trajectory-state runs. Evaluate every final actor against the original 27-cell quality gate. No seed/checkpoint selection or intermediate qualification.
costs: 360 of 603 paired physical records are reused; only 243 episodes are new. Report new provider CPU time separately from inherited reset-arm fitting/evaluation and common collection costs. Retain standalone learner accounting, but do not count reused bytes/episodes as newly collected. No successful speedup or cost-to-target follows unless the unchanged quality gate is passed.
scope: Paired actor-origin training from shared prior/data, reusing the verified reset baseline. Known training-family coverage only; not unseen motion, full SuperMimic reproduction, hardware qualification or a new default algorithm.
protocol_revision_reason: Actual controlled test of reset-only versus trajectory-state actor imagination after the failed tail-training comparison. Preserve all sampling, architecture, fitting, update and quality budgets. The intended intervention is uniform physical-transition rather than uniform reset-state sampling, including its episode-length weighting.
